{{Current events|year=2019|month=09|day=11|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**China publishes a list of 16 U.S. goods that will be temporarily exempted from its retaliatory import tariffs. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/china-exempts-some-u-s-goods-from-retaliatory-tariffs-as-fresh-talks-loom-idUSKCN1VW0IP (Reuters)]
**China announces that it will allow the import of [[soybean meal]] from [[Argentina]], to ensure livestock feed under the impact of the trade war with the U.S. Apart from Argentina, China has been increasing imports of soybeans and soymeal from other channels, such as allowing soybean meal, rapeseed meal and sunflower meal from Russia since September 6. [http://www.globaltimes.cn/content/1164329.shtml (Global Times)]
*[[2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute]]
**[[South Korea]] announces it will file a complaint with the [[World Trade Organization]] over [[Japan]]ese government export controls. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/south-korea-will-complain-to-wto-about-japans-trade-curbs-2019-09-10?link=MW_latest_news (Marketwatch)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*A crash of a twin-engine [[Convair 440]] cargo plane near [[Toledo, Ohio]], kills the two people on board. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/11/us/ohio-toledo-plane-crash/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Effects of Hurricane Dorian in The Bahamas]]
**The [[The Bahamas|Bahamian]] National Emergency Management Agency lists approximately 2,500 people as missing after [[Hurricane Dorian]] devastated the islands last week. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-49666942 (BBC)] 

;International relations
*[[List of pastoral visits of Pope Francis#2019|Pastoral visit of Pope Francis to Africa]]
**At [[St. Peter's Square]] [[Pope Francis]] reviews highlights from his African visit to [[Mozambique]], [[Madagascar]] and [[Mauritius]] on September 4-10. [https://cruxnow.com/vatican/2019/09/11/africa-trip-planted-new-seeds-of-hope-pope-says-at-audience/ (Crux)]

;Politics and elections
*Suffering from [[pneumonia]], [[Prime Minister of Tonga|Tongan Prime Minister]] [[ʻAkilisi Pōhiva]] is rushed from hospital in [[Nukuʻalofa]] to one in [[Auckland]], [[New Zealand]], where he was treated for a liver condition earlier this year. According to a government spokesperson, Pōhiva is in a "very serious" condition. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/398579/tongan-pm-akilisi-pohiva-medevaced-to-auckland (RNZ)]
*[[B.J. Habibie]], reformist Indonesian president, dies at 83, after spending more than a week in intensive care. [https://beta.washingtonpost.com/local/obituaries/bj-habibie-reformist-indonesian-president-dies-at-83/2019/09/11/aef7ea16-d493-11e9-9610-fb56c5522e1c_story.html?noredirect=on (The Washington Post)]
*[[Prime Minister of Japan|Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]] rearranges [[Cabinet of Japan#Current_Cabinet_of_Japan|his government cabinet]], naming replacements at the [[Minister of Defense (Japan)|Defense]], [[Minister for Foreign Affairs (Japan)|Foreign Affairs]], [[Minister of the Environment (Japan)|Environment]] and [[2020 Summer Olympics|Olympics]] [[Ministries of Japan|ministries]], among others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/japan-pm-picks-foreign-defence-ministers-reshuffle-190911043258966.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**[[Scotland]]'s [[Court of Session]] rules that [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] violated the law by his [[2019 British prorogation controversy|suspension of Parliament from 9 September to 14 October]], encouraging calls for MPs to get back to work immediately. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-watson/brexit-in-chaos-after-court-rules-pms-suspension-of-parliament-was-unlawful-idUSKCN1VV2S6 (Reuters)]
**The [[Johnson ministry]] releases the [[Operation Yellowhammer]] contingency plans in the event of a [[no-deal Brexit]] to the public. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49670123 (BBC)]
*[[2019 Canadian federal election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] calls a general election on 21 October. [[Governor General of Canada|Governor General]] [[Julie Payette]], the [[Viceroy|acting head of state]], formally dissolves [[Parliament of Canada|Parliament]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/canada-election-federal-general-justin-trudeau-news-latest-a9101286.html (''The Independent'')]

;Science and technology
*Scientists from Denmark and the United Kingdom report they have identified genetic information from a 1.7-million-year-old ''[[Stephanorhinus]]'' tooth enamel from [[Dmanisi historic site|Dmanisi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], making it the oldest genetic data ever recorded. [https://cosmosmagazine.com/palaeontology/the-oldest-genetic-data-ever-recorded (''Cosmos'')] 
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**[[Water vapor]] is detected on [[exoplanet]] [[K2-18b]], a [[super-Earth]] which is located about 111 [[light-years]] away from [[Earth]]. It is the first time water has been confirmed on an exoplanet within the [[circumstellar habitable zone]] of a star. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-49648746 (BBC)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/water-vapor-on-potentially-habitable-super-earth-exoplanet-2019-9 (Business Insider)]
